findings.description: The remote host is running an application that uses a version of Apache Log4j affected by a remote code execution vulnerability. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this by sending a specially crafted request containing a JNDI lookup, leading to full system compromise.
findings.solution: Upgrade Apache Log4j to version 2.17.1 or later. As a mitigation, set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true or remove the JndiLookup class from the classpath.

findings.description: SMB signing is not required on the remote host. An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this to conduct man-in-the-middle attacks and relay SMB authentication to other hosts.
findings.solution: Enable mandatory SMB signing in the host's network security policy. On Windows, configure 'Microsoft network server: Digitally sign communications (always)' to Enabled via Group Policy.
